items.title: Reliance Brands FY26 revenue up 3.8% to Rs 3,390.9 crore; loss narrows to Rs 137 crore
items.description: Reliance Brands has marked a significant financial milestone, achieving a revenue of Rs 3,390.89 crore for FY26 and reducing losses. Operating more than 1,085 Points of Sale nationwide, the brand continues to collaborate with over 90 partner names. Recent acquisitions, including Hamleys and new entries like Stella McCartney and Fabletics, demonstrate the company’s drive to lead in the competitive fashion and lifestyle industry.
